newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: ASB Bank cuts New Zealand fixed mortgage rates.
newsitem.headline: ASB Bank cuts New Zealand fixed mortgage rates.

text.p: ASB Bank Ltd on Thursday cut its fixed mortgage lending rates across the board, a spokesperson said.
The bank's one year rate fell to 8.25 percent from 8.5 percent, while the two and three year fixed rates are now 8.75 percent, down from 9.2 and 9.45 percent respectively.
The four and five year rates fell to 9.25 percent, from 9.75 and 9.9 percent respectively. The bank's six-month rate dropped to 7.95 percent from 8.35 percent.
